rationale.A: Viikki/Arabia paths, then 450 m in mixed traffic on Hermannin rantatie (40 km/h); 5 lights
rationale.B: Same as A, but on the path beside Hermannin rantatie; 4 lights
rationale.C: Same corridor, via service roads past the Hermannin rantatie junctions; no traffic; 2 lights; one unsignalised Hermannin rantatie crossing; +1 min
rationale.D: Quiet Hermanni streets (Vellamonkatu) instead of the Hermannin rantatie corridor; 120 m on Haukilahdenkatu; +4 min
rationale.E: Via Herttoniemi and 1.1 km mixed on Kulosaaren puistotie; 1 light; +4 min
rationale.F: No traffic, but long paths beside Hämeentie with two unsignalised Hämeentie crossings
rationale.G: Kumpula/Arabia side streets and paths, no traffic, ~3.8 km beside roads
rationale.H: No traffic, but seven unsignalised crossings (Viikintie, Hernepellontie, Hämeentie); +8 min

notes: C saves 3 lights for +1 min and drops A's Hermannin rantatie traffic stretch. B is calmest but saves only one light; C is nearly as calm. Ambiguous whether C counts as the same route as A/B (it differs by about a block through Kyläsaari).
